verdicts.reason: Both use the same cramped leaderboard layout. The tagline is squeezed into a narrow 5-line italic column, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is shrunk to illegible size and moved below the headline, which breaks the reading order. The RSVP button is just one more pill among the three badges, so the CTA is buried. The placeholder for the missing partner asset is jammed under the logo. A keeps the sun icon on the Solstice logo; B appears to lose it and shows a bigger placeholder box, so A is very slightly better.
